title: Crispy Courgette Fritters
description: A delicious Mexican-inspired snack or side dish made with crispy courgette fritters.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C (350°F).
2. In a bowl, mix together the grated courgette, crispy breadcrumbs, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
3. In a separate bowl, beat the egg.
4. Add the egg to the courgette mixture and mix well.
5. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the mixture into the hot oil.
6. Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel to drain excess oil.
8. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
9. If using cheese, sprinkle on top of the fritters before serving.
